Variants.Content: Hellgate Castle is located in the southwest inland of Dorne and is the ancestral castle of the Uller family. It belongs to the jurisdiction of the Prince of Dorne, and the surrounding area is hot, dry and remote. The evil reputation of the Uller family and old feuds on the border make this castle often associated with revenge, imprisonment and harsh hospitality in Dornish stories.

Entry Hellholt Local families also rely on wells, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and travel to avoid the hot sun; if any road, well, or dock fails, the cost falls first on them.
Entry Hellholt They also recognize Dornish accents, laws and credentials; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Hellholt If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

Stone and wood will decay, but Hellgate Castle still relies on craftsmen to take care of the stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs, and the seams left by generations of repairs, and relies on clergy to preserve the common memory of the Seven Gods, the legacy of Rhoynar, and the different bloodlines under the prince's rule. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Hellholt They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
